# PatchLedger

> An evidence-first, open-source security finding and remediation verification platform for developers. Runs established scanners (semgrep, gitleaks, bandit, pip-audit, trivy), normalizes their findings into one persistent SQLite ledger with deterministic fingerprints and explainable risk scores, and verifies that vulnerabilities were actually fixed — with scanner-coverage evidence — before marking them resolved. No AI API, no cloud, no telemetry; fully functional offline.

Key facts:

- Language: Python 3.10+ (tested through 3.14)
- License: MIT
- Install: `pipx install patchledger` (or `pip install patchledger`)
- Core promise: a vanished finding is only `resolved` when every scanner that ever reported it ran successfully against the same target in the newer scan; otherwise it is `inconclusive` with recorded reasons.
- No AI API required. `patchledger export-ai` generates an offline review prompt for any external assistant.
- Report formats: JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML (no JavaScript), SARIF 2.1.0 output.

## CLI commands

- `patchledger init [PATH]`: initialize a project (creates .patchledger/ with config and SQLite database)
- `patchledger scan [PATH]`: run installed scanners, normalize, dedup, score, store one scan; `--fail-on SEVERITY` (exit 2), `--strict` (exit 3 on incomplete scans), `--scanner NAME` (repeatable), `--label TEXT`
- `patchledger import FILE...`: import existing reports (SARIF 2.1.0, semgrep JSON, gitleaks JSON, bandit JSON, pip-audit JSON; auto-detected)
- `patchledger findings`: current per-finding ledger; filters `--severity`, `--status`, `--scanner`, `--rule`; `--json`
- `patchledger history`: list recorded scans with tool statuses
- `patchledger compare SCAN_A SCAN_B`: diff two scans
- `patchledger verify [--baseline ID]`: coverage-aware resolution verification with recorded reasons
- `patchledger report`: generate JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML, or SARIF (`--format`)
- `patchledger export-ai`: offline AI-review prompt (Markdown or JSON); `--min-severity`, `--max-findings`
- `patchledger doctor`: installation health (python, scanners, config, database)
